ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-10-31..2026-07-31

dividends_paid.basis: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements

buybacks.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements) + buybacks NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-10-31..2026-07-31

legs.buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters

buyback_yield.note: buybacks not filed for the window — null

legs.buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.note: buybacks not filed for the window — null

legs.dividends_paid: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements
legs.buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.note: a lower bound — a positive leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

dividend_yield.label: —
dividend_yield.note: no dividends-per-share facts filed (CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared / CashPaid or IFRS equivalents) and no dividends paid — not a dividend payer

buyback_yield.label: —
buyback_yield.note: buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.label: —
net_buyback_yield.note: buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters; share_issuance: 4/4 quarters filed

shareholder_yield.label: ≥ -0.18%
shareholder_yield.note: buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters — left out, so this yield is a lower bound

notes: no dividends-per-share facts filed (CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared / CashPaid or IFRS equivalents) and no dividends paid — not a dividend payer

dividends_paid_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed dividends_paid figure (missing 2025-10-31, 2026-01-31, 2026-04-30, 2026-07-31) — the tag was never filed in any period, so the leg counts as zero
buybacks_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed buybacks figure (missing 2025-10-31, 2026-01-31, 2026-04-30, 2026-07-31)
